outside_width.evidence: HB134: 6-5/8 inches; interpreted as outside width

sheet_stock.interpretation: Sheet steel is documented; thickness is not located. Bounds express uncertainty, not a validated operating range.

chain_radial_envelope.interpretation: Conservative section envelope for the current chain bars, pins and cotters.

radial_gap.interpretation: Chain section to inside casing contour allowance; installed static fit is checked separately.

hub_gap.interpretation: Radial clearance around the existing reconstructed sprocket hubs; no seal is yet represented.

cap_split_gap.interpretation: Separated cap/body edges for this static candidate; register plates and beading remain to be installed.

cap_split_axis_height.interpretation: Horizontal cap seam relative to the roller-pinion axis. It leaves an open half-bore in the cap, consistent with removing the cap before the pinion; the source does not dimension or independently establish this seam.

passage_straight_gap.interpretation: Inflation of the actual casing section bounds at both wall faces. Four mm with an8mm opening corner gives at least2.34mm around a square section corner; native minimum clearance is also checked.

passage_corner_radius.interpretation: Retain the previous inferred wall-opening radius while accounting for the casing corners.

passage_minimum_gap.interpretation: Minimum native wall clearance required for the casing candidate; not a source manufacturing tolerance.

contour_interpretation: Two analytic pitch-circle offsets joined by their external common tangents. Their offset is chain envelope plus radial gap plus sheet stock. Subtract the corresponding inner contour and two hub passages to make a connected sheet-shell reconstruction. This is a gross contour, not a tracing of an independently dimensioned casing drawing.
cap_interpretation: The rear upper part over the roller pinion is a separate M1591 cap. Its forward boundary is one large outer contour radius ahead of the pinion axis; its lower boundary is at the pinion axis. This inferred split leaves the cap hub passage open to its lower edge. No pose or service-motion qualification is claimed.
